{{Top|leg}}
An '''Ambience shroud''' was a portable device used to conceal the heat signatures of organisms and vehicles from [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. It consisted of a sheet of flexible material supported by four telescoping poles with ground spikes and was powered by a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] mounted beneath the shroud.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Voort saBinring]] deployed an ambience shroud over a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] during [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Firefight at Glitterby Base|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]], where it compensated for the heat rising from those beneath it, making the vehicle difficult for infrared sensors in satellites and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to detect.<ref name="MK" />
